purpose: Two complete source-grounded intraday lab recipes and replication of the retained Bollinger recipe; not exact reproductions of an unpublished discretionary system.

sources.reviewed: Full available article text, especially Trend Pullback Trading entry, stop and profit criteria; no chart-video or linked course review claimed.
sources.adopted_principle: Join an established move after retracement into support/resistance; protect beyond the structure that invalidates it, and plan an exit. The source offers alternatives rather than a unique algorithm.
not_supplied_by_author: fixed six-observed-row cap and nominal2R target

sources.reviewed: Full available article text, steps, entry/exit logic, worked example, confirmation, limitations and FAQ. No linked paid course or video review claimed.
sources.adopted_principle: A broken level is retested from the other side. Wait for a completed rejection before entry; place protection beyond the retest extreme and choose a declared structural or risk-multiple target. A fixed2R target is one published option, not a guarantee.
not_supplied_by_author: prior20-bar channel as the level definition
sources.excluded_optional_confirmations: No exchange-volume, news-calendar, higher-timeframe or order-flow confirmation is fabricated from this single BID candle stream.
sources.chronology: This source was published after the2025 replay months. These are retrospective discovery experiments designed in2026, not a strategy genuinely forecast in2025.

sources.reviewed: Full available lesson text and worked tick-risk example.
sources.adopted_principle: Determine meaningful invalidation and the allowed account loss before sizing; a wider stop requires a smaller position for the same risk budget.
sources.lab_risk_choice: Existing1% maximum executable stop-risk and5x leverage ceiling are retained. The sample's other possible risk percentages are not adopted. Commission, spread/slippage and carry remain in the existing execution/account owner.

complete_operational_methods.control: Existing closed EMA20/50 pretrend/touch/reclaim entry with ADX/RSI and native ATR stop/target.
complete_operational_methods.recipe: Same entry and confidence; invalidation is the most adverse extreme of the actual three closed setup bars, buffered by one execution point. Existing actual next-open fill determines the nominal2R target and cost-aware risk size.
complete_operational_methods.difference: Structural protection/target only; the whole account can still change entry eligibility, sizing and later opportunities. Not an isolated same-entry exit effect.

complete_operational_methods.control: Existing registered rolling-level trend-retest implementation and ATR protection, not silently rewritten.
complete_operational_methods.recipe: Freeze the original preceding 20-bar level at breakout; accept a later directional rejection within three contiguous bars, with EMA20/50 and ADX. The existing confidence equation measures distance to this topology's own frozen level, retaining its ADX strength transform, clipped distance/ATR transform and 0.35 threshold. Stop beyond the rejection extreme plus one execution point; target nominal 2R from actual fill.
complete_operational_methods.difference: Entry topology, its level-relative confidence and structural protection change together. Missing frozen level is unavailable/WAIT, never a confidence floor. The control's rolling-level formula is unchanged. No individual entry/exit causal credit is available from this two-arm bundle.

common_choices.fills: existing prior-closed-input/next-modeled-open and native conservative intrabar/gap rules
common_choices.risk_reward_boundary: 2R describes price distance to initial structural stop; actual net risk/reward is lower after costs. No broker demo or tick fill is claimed.

data_boundary: Exactly June and September2025 native full-month slices plus200 real warmup rows. Both lack observed quotes. Existing modeled costs are not relabeled observed BID/ASK or broker execution. January/February/March calendar refusals are retained; no candles are fabricated.
library_agent_separation: Curator source/rule/outcome records are not an agent's earned experience. A promising recipe may be handed to a fresh admitted research agent only with its exact evidence status; that agent needs its own original use and comparison.
